title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
abstract: arXiv:2610.00224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. translated_title: Build2SPARQL：面向建筑知识图谱查询的大规模文本到SPARQL基准数据集
translated_abstract: 建筑自动化系统越来越多地使用Brick和ASHRAE 223P等本体被表示为语义知识图谱（KG），为人工智能应用提供了机器可读的基础。一个有前景的应用是将自然语言问题翻译成SPARQL查询（文本到SPARQL），这将使建筑运营人员能够通过语言智能体查询这些图谱，但该领域的进展受限于大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准数据集的稀缺。本文提出了Build2SPARQL，这是一个由知识图谱接地流程生成的大规模建筑KG基准数据集：SPARQL查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，而大型语言模型仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而确保查询的正确性独立于模型行为。该流程挖掘了六种查询模式族——线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL和属性过滤——并对每个查…
tldr: 本文提出了Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模文本到SPARQL基准数据集，其核心创新在于采用图遍历代码完全生成和验证SPARQL查询、大语言模型仅生成自然语言问题的流程设计，使查询正确性不受模型行为影响。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale text-to-SPARQL benchmark dataset for building knowledge graphs, whose key innovation lies in a KG-grounded pipeline that generates and validates SPARQL queries entirely through graph-traversal code while LLMs only produce natural-language questions, ensuring query correctness independent of model behavior.
